name: Depraved Town: Forgotten Memories
source: Follow a young Ayako and decide between different paths how her life could have been. Only one of these paths is the true and canonical one. This game story and characters will heavily influence Depraved Town main story.
translation: 跟随年轻时的Ayako，在不同道路间作出选择，看看她的人生原本可能走向何方。其中只有一条道路才是真正的正史。本作的故事与人物，将对《Depraved Town》的主线剧情产生重大影响。
